question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"looked."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**looked after**" is an idiomatic expression meaning to take care of or provide for someone.
 
• In the context of the passage, it aptly describes how guests are treated with care and attention within the family setting.
 
• The use of "**looked**" is necessary for the idiomatic expression to be correctly completed. Without it, the sentence would not convey the intended meaning of care and hospitality.
